description: This file defines internal CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) classes and functions for the Abseil C++ library, including CRC implementation classes, constants, and utility functions related to CRC calculations.

classes.name: CRCImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing CRC functionality, including table filling and CRC extension methods.

classes.name: CRC32
classes.description: Concrete implementation of CRC for 32-bit CRC calculations, supporting extension, scrambling, and zero extension.

methods.name: NewInternal
methods.description: Creates a new internal CRC implementation instance.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Resets or initializes the CRC value.

methods.name: FillWordTable
methods.description: Fills a table for CRC extension by one word.

methods.name: FillZeroesTable
methods.description: Builds a table for extending CRC with zero bytes.

methods.name: InitTables
methods.description: Initializes CRC tables; implemented in derived classes.

methods.name: Scramble
methods.description: Scrambles the CRC value for non-linearity.
